ERR_SESSION_VERSION.message: The other board speaks frame format {got}, this one {mine}
ERR_SESSION_VERSION.hint: Update both boards to the same firmware.

ERR_SESSION_NONE.message: A frame from {src} came before it said who it is
ERR_SESSION_NONE.hint: It is asked to say it again; nothing to do.

ERR_SESSION_ID_TAKEN.hint: Give one of them another id.

ERR_SESSION_NO_ROUTE.message: Board {dst} cannot be reached from here

ERR_SESSION_TIMEOUT.hint: A write may still have run: read the value back.

ERR_SESSION_PEER_DOWN.message: The connection to board {board} was lost

ERR_SESSION_ROLE.message: A board connected to a master takes no other connection: no app, no other board

ERR_SESSION_NOT_FRAMED.message: A session needs a link that carries a whole frame; this one is raw
ERR_SESSION_NOT_FRAMED.hint: Attach a framed provider. A raw one is for a stream or a command binding.

ERR_SESSION_FULL.message: No room for another board connection

ERR_SESSION_CALLS_FULL.message: Too many requests to other boards at once

ERR_SESSION_BUSY.message: Board {dst} is still answering earlier requests
ERR_SESSION_BUSY.hint: It is sent again later; nothing to do.

ERR_SESSION_WOULD_BLOCK.message: A wait for another board's answer was asked where nothing may wait
